templates.source: https://web.archive.org/web/2020/http://www.iqeye.com/Collateral/Documents/English-US/Products/IQDocs-Dwgs/Network%20API%20manual_Vicon.pdf — IQeye Network API Manual (IQinVision/Vicon, 2014-04-05), §10.1.1: request an H.264 stream via unicast/multicast UDP or unicast TCP with rtsp://<camera_ip>/now.mp4 (RTSP control on TCP port 554; RTSP listener port OID default 554).

notes: Official IQeye Network API Manual (archived copy of iqeye.com): rtsp://<camera_ip>/now.mp4 is the H.264 RTSP request URL for all IQeye cameras (§10.1.1; HTTP-tunnelled variant http://<camera_ip>/rtsp/now.mp4). §10.4 documents modifiers: append &res=low to get the lower-resolution H.264 stream when the configured mode provides one, &mm=v for video only. Cameras of the IQ76/IQ86, IQA3, IQD5, IQM5 and IQR5 families can also be run in stream-based operation, where §10.3 lists rtsp://<camera_ip>/stream1 … /stream4 for streams 1-4. No sub-stream template is listed here because the documented sub-stream URL differs between mode-based and stream-based operation.
